summary: TRANSFORMATION CONTRACT GAP (GN-77): finds the ratified canon 'defines when a transition would be ILLEGAL without ever defining what a transition IS' -- two legality constraints (I-12, the covering-relation/no-skip rule; A6, the authority-crosses-not-evidence rule) are ratified, but preconditions reach only 'mentioned' once (describing Authorization's role, not any operation's precondition), postconditions are never even mentioned (zero occurrences of 'postcondition'/'post-condition' anywhere in model/ or final-architecture/), and preservation obligations and rejection/invalid-transition semantics are both 'not established'; identifies three dependencies (operation registry, state identity/equality, a closed invariant register) that make Transformations un-fillable in isolation, formally declaring Transformations = BLOCKED / NOT CANONICAL, blocked primarily behind the operation registry.
